title.value: Multi-reservoir ESN-based prediction strategy for dynamic multi-objective optimization
title.justification: The title directly mentions the main focus of the paper, which is the use of multi-reservoir ESN for prediction in dynamic multi-objective optimization.
title.quote: Multi-reservoir ESN-based prediction strategy for dynamic multi-objective optimization

analysis.description: The paper proposes a prediction strategy that integrates a multi-reservoir Echo State Network (MRESN) with a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm for dynamic multi-objective optimization problems. This approach aims to enhance the prediction by considering complex correlations among decision variables, improving the performance in dynamic environments.

type.justification: The paper involves experimental results demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed MRESN-MOEA/D algorithm through simulations and real-world applications.
type.quote: Finally, MRESN-MOEA/D is applied in both simulated benchmarks and an actual dynamical wastewater treatment system. The experiment results illustrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms other state-of-the-art methods with better convergence and diversity.
